# v0.9.0b4 — The app's orders from Home Assistant

Update the app to **0.9.0b4** together with the integration. Both versions
must match: the exchange between them changed.

- **Charging jobs, boost and guest charging from Home Assistant.** Six new
  actions start, stop and clear a charging job, start guest charging and start
  and end a boost, each in one step. With one wallbox no device ID is needed.
  The new sensor **Charging job** shows the order's state, window, current,
  energy and progress. [Use the app from Home Assistant](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b4/docs/app-from-home-assistant.md)
  has a ready dashboard view with Mushroom cards.
- **With the app, wallbox settings live in one place.** **Configure →
  Wallbox** only shows the app's current cap and waits; they are changed in
  the app. Home Assistant adds no current cap of its own for an app
  connection.
- **Weekly plans are removed.** The app has no Weekly plans page or API any
  more. Recurring departures come from a calendar: the calendar blueprint sets
  **Next departure**. A saved `weekly-plans.json` is no longer read.
- **A stop always wins.** A stop of a charging job counts from the moment it
  is asked for, also while the app is still writing a start, and acts at once;
  a start waits for the minimum time between state changes.
- **The registers are a page below Overview again,** with the complete table.
- **No unformatted or English page for a moment after a click.** Pages carry
  their styles inside and appear once their texts are in your language.

[All changes](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b4/CHANGELOG.md)
